title: Math Mentor learning-state event
description: Structural contract for one append-only learning event. Structural validity is not semantic validity: passing this schema does not make a transition legal, does not grant authority, and does not persist anything. Legality is decided by the transition table in reduce_readonly.py. Events live in the local CityState store, never in this public repository.

event_id.description: Unique within a store; duplicates are rejected by the reducer.

student_ref.description: Privacy-safe alias or hash only. Real identity is forbidden by STUDENT_LEARNING_STATE_SCHEMA.md section 2.

actually_read_files.description: Self-declared and non-verifiable; never upstream evidence in a correctness chain (TEACHING_AGENT_CONTRACTS.md section 2).

learning_state_epoch.description: Must equal the bound epoch in epoch.yml; mismatched events are ignored by the reducer.

corrects_event_id.description: Non-null only for correction events; the target event is superseded, never deleted.

human_authorization_ref.description: Required for any transition into graduated. A model-supplied value is not authority.

prev_event_digest.description: SHA-256 of the previous event file, forming the integrity chain that replaces Git immutability in the local store.
